callMe.label: “Call me” when someone struggles at checkout
callMe.help: Shows a small “Call me” offer only when a customer struggles: after the set number of refused tries on one box, or after the set seconds without progress. A tap leaves a call-back in Support with his number. There is no permanent button. Off until switched on.

text.tries: Please call me — I could not get past the {field} box at checkout.
text.idle: Please call me — I stopped at checkout and need help.
